scope: Wire-encoding and message-framing vector conformance for BOLT 1 BigSize/TLV, the BOLT 8 transport frame, and finite BOLT 2 open_channel/accept_channel/commitment_signed/update_add_htlc payload vectors, plus pinned rust-lightning differential fixtures and a recorded live rust-lightning run. The BOLT 8 transport model is promoted to LnLean.Wire.Transport in LnLean/Wire/Message.lean; the payload-only Wire.unframe is unchanged. This is NOT a full implementation test: it checks encoded bytes and the modelled accept/reject decisions for a finite vector set. IO, allocation limits, message-specific TLV value decoding, namespace/known-type policy, Noise encryption, signature validity, and byte-for-byte equivalence with a running rust-lightning node are out of scope.

framing.length_semantics: transport_length = 2 + payload.size = WireMessage.messageSize; the BOLT 8 length covers the type and payload, not the payload alone
framing.model_note: LnLean.Wire.frame is the abstract payload-only frame type || payload.size || payload; LnLean.Wire.Transport.transportFrame is the BOLT 8 frame type || (2 + payload.size) || payload, promoted to LnLean/Wire/Message.lean. LnLean.Wire.unframe remains payload-only and rejects every transport frame (LnLean.Wire.Transport.unframe_transportFrame_eq_none).
